title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Reservation Terms by Equipment Class
content:
Reservation figures of Ridgeline Tool Rental by equipment class: how far ahead equipment may be booked, how long it is held, the reservation deposit, the cancellation notice and whether the deposit is forfeited.

| Equipment class | Booked up to, calendar days before pickup | Held after the booked pickup time, hours | Reservation deposit, USD | Cancellation notice for a full release, hours before pickup | Deposit forfeited on late cancellation or no-show |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 30 | 2 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 30 | 2 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 30 | 2 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 30 | 4 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 60 | 4 | 100.00 | 24 | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 60 | 4 | 250.00 | 48 | yes |

A reservation deposit of 0.00 means that no reservation deposit is collected in that class.

## Reading the table

- An aerial lift may be booked up to 60 days ahead; a floor sander up to 30.
- Reserved concrete equipment stays held for 4 hours past its booked pickup time; hand and power tools, floor and surface care and lawn and landscape items for 2 hours.
- Only Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting (100.00, 24 hours' notice) and Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment (250.00, 48 hours' notice) take a reservation deposit, and only those two classes forfeit it.

## Hypothetical example

An excavator in Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment is booked for pickup at 07:00 on a Thursday. The reservation deposit is 250.00 and the notice for a full release is 48 hours, which reaches back to 07:00 on the Tuesday.
